title: Mawlid – the birth of Muhammad (SAW)
intro: We rejoice at the birth of the last and most chosen Messenger of Allah.

learn.html: Mawlid is the day we rejoice at the birth of the most chosen and last Messenger of Allah, Muhammad (SAW). He was born on the 12th of Rabi‘ al-Awwal, 571, in Makkah, in Arabia. His father was ‘Abdullah and his mother Aminah. His family, Banu Hashim, belonged to the most respected Arab tribe, Quraysh.
On the day of his birth we recite the mawlid – a poem about the Prophet’s life – and we mark the whole month of Rabi‘ al-Awwal with special programmes.

Let us recite the mawlid for Muhammad,
let us all thank him with full hearts!
Let it be warm thanks from all of us
to the Prophet who showed the way to safety.

Mawlid, mawlid – Muhammad’s birthday,
darkness is gone, a new day dawns!
Muhammad was given as a gift to mankind –
let us send salawat on the chosen one:
(From the mawlid poem of Rešad Kadić, English translation)

learn.label: Salawat
learn.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَبِيبَ اللَّهِ، الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَفِيعَ اللَّهِ
learn.tr: As-salaatu was-salaamu ‘alayka yaa Rasoolallaah! As-salaatu was-salaamu ‘alayka yaa Habeeballaah! As-salaatu was-salaamu ‘alayka yaa Shafee‘allaah!
learn.en: Allah’s blessing and peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah! … O beloved of Allah! … O intercessor with Allah!
